description: Enhanced native-disjoint boundary coverage for SPIR-V cross-compilation: minimal valid Vulkan/WebGPU modules and invalid-module normalization across targets and source environments.

input.assembly:
OpCapability Shader
          OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450
          OpEntryPoint Vertex %main "main"
%void   = OpTypeVoid
%void_f = OpTypeFunction %void
%main   = OpFunction %void None %void_f
%label  = OpLabel
          OpReturn
          OpFunctionEnd

OpCapability Shader
          OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450
          OpEntryPoint Vertex %main "main"
%void   = OpTypeVoid
%void_f = OpTypeFunction %void
%main   = OpFunction %void None %void_f
%label  = OpLabel
          OpReturn
          OpFunctionEnd

OpCapability Shader
          OpCapability VulkanMemoryModelKHR
          OpExtension "SPV_KHR_vulkan_memory_model"
          OpMemoryModel Logical VulkanKHR
          OpEntryPoint Vertex %func "wg_main"
%void   = OpTypeVoid
%void_f = OpTypeFunction %void
%func   = OpFunction %void None %void_f
%label  = OpLabel
          OpReturn
          OpFunctionEnd
